ITEM.PTXT: The driver's requested yaw rate is calculated from the steering amount and vehicle speed and compared with the actual vehicle yaw rate to determine the understeer tendency. According to the degree of the tendency, engine output is suppressed and the brakes are applied, generating a moment in the same direction as the vehicle's turning direction and suppressing excessive understeer. At the same time, an EPS assist torque command is sent to prevent the driver from oversteering the steering wheel and worsening the understeer tendency.
